description: Meet Rep. Josiah Hill, Minnesota House District 33B. A lifelong Stillwater resident, Stillwater Area High School graduate, and 19-year public school English teacher, Josiah holds degrees from UW-Madison, UW-River Falls, and a Doctorate from Hamline University. A former teachers' union president, father of three, and committed community leader, he is dedicated to building thriving, resilient communities across the St. Croix Valley for all working families and future generations.
